notes.title: Version 4.1.0 (27 June 2018)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31326688/3e458ebe4170769e4f46b62bf6e68d68a7aeee8b.png[/img]

What's new:

Added more languages to the game. Now you can play Holyday City Reloaded in the following languages.

English, German, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Portuguese (Brazil), Greek, Russian, Spanish, French (France), Italian, Polish, Turkish

I would like to remind you that the game was originally made in English, so some translations may not be 100% accurate. Let us know if you find something that is wrong in the translations.

I want to thank everyone for reporting issues you encounter!

What's New:

* New Expansion. Holyday Island expansion has been added into the game. The content is available for players lvl 30+.

* New Cities. We added 4 new cities, level 37-40 with new content.

notes.title: Version 2.0.7 (24 December 2017)
notes.content:
What's New:

* Login Bonus. Added a notification to let you know when it has expired.

* Bug Fixing. We solved the bug that in some cases offline earnings were less than they should.

* Tutorial. The tutorials that ask you to buy a specific business were poping up while you had the money to buy 1 of that building. If you had swiched the buy mode to either x10 or x100 the building continued being gray (disabled) though. That could cause some frustration to the new players. So from now on if a tutorial popup appears for a specific business the buy mode will reset to x1 in order to allow you to buy that business.

* Typo fixes.

* Christmas Sale. Due to the spirit of the days a Mega Sale is available for you! +30% value on Holybars and event tickets plus other gifts. (Starting at 12/24/2017, 12:00 UTC time)

I want to thank everyone for reporting issues you encounter!

Support: http://holydaygames.com/support/ 

FB page: https://www.facebook.com/holydaycity 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/HolydayCity

notes.title: Version 2.0.6 (19 December 2017)
notes.content:
What's New:

* Login Bonus. During the Winter Festival event we added a Login Bonus into the game. Once you log into the game, for the next 12 hours your Snowballs will be generated every 4 minutes and 30 seconds instead of every 5. This is a 11% bonus in the Snowballs so that makes it 11% more event tickets. This action serves as a small reward to the active users. You will also generate 10% more profits from every source (Businesses, Port, Payouts).

* Social Media Code redirect. Inside the settings menu at the support tab we added a button that will redirect you to the Store, Daily Gifts tab. This is to avoid confusing of writing the social media code into the support code input box.

* "Esc". After you log into the game and you play either Play or Play Muted you can use the "Esc" hotkey to exit the game. Once you do that a popup will appear that you can either confirm or cancel the "Save & Exit" from the game.

I want to thank everyone for reporting issues you encounter!

Support: http://holydaygames.com/support/ 

FB page: https://www.facebook.com/holydaycity 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/HolydayCity
